clause: LUT/color-space/creative adjustments (Color Lookup/LUT, OCIO, Soft Proof, Normals, Clarity/Dehaze/Grain) [STU-RAS-035]

scope.summary: Implement the LUT/color-space/creative StudioAdjustment kinds over the framework (MT-054): Color Lookup/LUT (3D LUT / abstract / device-link tables for graded looks), OCIO (OpenColorIO source-to-destination color-space transform), Soft Proof (in-stack output-condition preview for a target space/device — same as MT-053 soft-proof, exposed as an adjustment), Normals (adjust/correct normal maps for 3D/game-art), and Clarity/Dehaze/Grain (midtone-contrast clarity, atmospheric dehaze, film-grain texture). OCIO/soft-proof consume ColorEngine (MT-019); do not fork.
acceptance_criteria: all 5 LUT/color-space/creative adjustment kinds as non-destructive layers + apply-in-place
proof_targets: Color-Lookup LUT + OCIO adjustment runtime + snapshot
expected_tests: live: apply a 3D LUT via Color Lookup; OCIO transform between two color spaces; Clarity/Dehaze changes midtone contrast — each a re-editable adjustment layer
test: OCIO/soft-proof route through ColorEngine (no forked transform)

target_entries: Studio / Raster / LUT, OCIO & creative adjustments

risk_if_missed: No LUT grading / OCIO / clarity-dehaze-grain; graded-look and 3D/game-art workflows absent.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
